title: Put Your Business Online in One Afternoon
summary: Get a simple one-page site with your services, phone and a contact form live today, then check it for the problems that stop people calling.

money_potential.label: Medium
money_potential.basis: Assumes you have no site today; the value is enquiries from customers who can now find and contact you.
money_potential.note: Value tiers are our rough estimates (labelled Estimate) of relative value to the business, each with its assumption. They are not promises, income claims or advice. Results depend on your market, offer and effort.

how_it_makes_money: Customers who search for you find a page they can call or message from.
No waiting weeks or paying for a full site before you have one page live.
who_its_for: Local service businesses with no website.
Side businesses that need one page to share.

steps: Answer the questions about your business, city, phone and services.
Open the page it publishes and fix the wording.
Run an audit on the live page and fix the top issues.
Share the link in your Google Business Profile and social bios.
guardrails: Check phone numbers, prices and hours before you share the link.
Use only photos you own or have the right to use.
